incident-bot: INCIDENT 1732102468 — automatic page: sustained p95/p99 latency increase and throughput drop in runtime-prod after recent release (hotwave). Affected: canary -> partial rollout. Escalating to on-call and runtime.
Sam Li: seeing kernel_fallback spikes on canary. Batching window jittered high and KV cache eviction rate blew up.
Maya Patel: numbers: p99 token latency +350ms, throughput -30% for traffic routed to release/hotwave. Error rate ~5% on affected slice. Kernel_fallback_count +120 in last 10m.
Oncall Pager: I'm on it — pulling logs from canary pods now and checking slow traces.
Alex Chen: can we flip the feature flag for the new batching strategy? fast_batch_v2 looks like the only recent change touching selector/batching.
Jin Park: I can flip via the FF service or staging UI. Will flip canary first and watch.
Leah Romero: CS report: two enterprise customers hit repeated timeouts (500s) and opened tickets. Notified account owners and legal touchpoint; we should prepare an external status update if this persists beyond 30m.
Sam Li: repro notes from canary logs:
```
[2026-03-12T14:02:33Z] kernel_selector: chosen_kernel=quant_fast path_seq_len=1024 indicies_mismatch=true
[2026-03-12T14:02:34Z] batching: window_ms=64 -> spike
[2026-03-12T14:02:36Z] kv_cache: evict_rate=0.78 bucket=runtime-pool-canary
```
Seems selector is preferring a quantized kernel that performs poorly with long sequences and triggers repeated fallback to CPU path, causing batch accumulation and latency tail.
Maya Patel: quick health check curl for flag:
`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/fast_batch_v2`
Oncall Pager: Jin — flip on canary and report immediate metric delta. If p95 improves, we do org-wide flip + initiate rollback of release/hotwave.
Jin Park: flipped fast_batch_v2=OFF on canary at 1732102600. Monitoring telemetry.
Jin Park: update — canary p95 down ~180ms, throughput +22%, kernel_fallback_count dropping.
Alex Chen: recommend immediate kill-switch (org) + rollback rollout. Starting rollback of deployment/hotwave now. I will run the rollback command and coordinate with release manager.
Alex Chen: executing: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --namespace=prod --to-revision=20260308-hotwave-pre` — initiating at 1732102705.
incident-bot: ACTION LOG: flag_flip by Jin Park (canary), rollback initiated by Alex Chen, page continued.
Leah Romero: CS update: informed impacted customers of mitigation steps and ETA ~30m for full stabilization. CS will update tickets and add status note.
Sam Li: mitigation checklist: 1) revert rollout 2) disable fast_batch_v2 globally 3) add selector safety gate 4) postmortem.
Maya Patel: short-term action item: add canary SLO gate on p95 and kernel_fallback_count > threshold to auto-halt rollouts.
Oncall Pager: rollback observing resource churn but healthy. Will watch for new error spikes for 30m. If stable, we'll close page and start incident write-up.
Jin Park: continuing to monitor logs and traces. If anyone needs traces: trace IDs prefixed with rw-runtime- can provide.
Alex Chen: after rollback completes I'll coordinate config change to keep fast_batch_v2 disabled until we patch kernel selector.
Leah Romero: saving notes for customer comms and escalation. Will follow up on support tickets with owners.
Sam Li: post-incident TODOs: tighten kernel selector thresholds, add synthetic canary test for long sequences, add explicit fallback backoff to avoid thrash, and add an emergency kill-switch runbook.
Oncall Pager: Handoff: I'm staying on for 30 more minutes; then hand off to next oncall (pager shift) if metrics are green for 1h. :thumbsup:
Jin Park: good catch everyone — ping me if anything regresses.
Maya Patel: adding this to /incidents for postmortem and linking rollout history.
